quality_guards: Lifting risk depends on equipment type, load, configuration, site, environment, competence, supervision and examination status.
HSE lifting evidence is equipment-, operation-, load-, site-, worker- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
Scaffold risk depends on design, height, loading, foundations, ties, weather, alteration, inspection and worker competence.
HSE scaffold evidence is structure-, site-, task-, weather-, inspection- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level fall probability.
Ventilation risk depends on room use, occupancy, building design, outdoor-air supply, pollutants, heat, maintenance and operating conditions.
HSE ventilation evidence is building-, room-, occupancy-, system-, pollutant- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level health probability.
Dermatitis risk depends on substance, concentration, wet work, contact duration, glove use, skin condition, hygiene and individual susceptibility.
HSE dermatitis evidence is substance-, task-, workplace-, control-, worker- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level disease probability.
Botulism risk depends on toxin source, food or wound pathway, preparation, dose, product authenticity, exposure timing and clinical response.
UKHSA botulism evidence is source-, pathway-, product-, patient-, treatment- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level illness probability.
Meningococcal risk depends on serogroup, contact intensity, setting, carriage, vaccination, host factors, symptoms and response timing.
UKHSA meningococcal evidence is case-, contact-, serogroup-, setting-, patient- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Diphtheria risk depends on organism, toxigenicity, symptoms, vaccination, contact setting, antimicrobial susceptibility and response timing.
UKHSA diphtheria evidence is case-, organism-, contact-, setting-, treatment- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Toy choking risk depends on intended age, component size, attachment strength, abuse testing, packaging, supervision and product condition.
OPSS toy evidence is product-, component-, test-, child-, use- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level choking probability.
Runway risk depends on aerodrome layout, traffic, visibility, markings, clearances, human performance, surface condition and local controls.
CAA runway evidence is aerodrome-, operation-, aircraft-, traffic-, weather- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level accident probability.
Rail electrical risk depends on voltage system, asset condition, isolation, earthing, access, competence, work method and operational context.
ORR electrical evidence is asset-, route-, system-, task-, worker- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level electrocution probability.
